businessCase.title:
Make the economics part
of the monthly conversation.
businessCase.description: Explore a scenario before you speak to us. This is a transparent calculation, not a forecast or a promised result.
notes: Contribution = net revenue × contribution margin − media spend. Scenario revenue = current revenue × (1 + change). MER = net revenue ÷ media spend. Agency fees, fixed overhead, tax and changes in cost structure are excluded. This is not profit, ROI, causal lift or a benchmark.
Calculations stay in this page. No account required.
Media spend and margin rate stay fixed in this scenario. Changing currency relabels amounts; no exchange conversion.

faq.title:
Good questions.
Clear answers.
faq.description:
Short answers to what enterprise teams usually
ask before a first call.

items.q: Is this for B2B or consumer brands?
items.a: Both. We work with brands that sell to consumers and with companies that sell to other businesses. Our four industry playbooks cover e-commerce, subscriptions and apps, education, and multi-location operators. For B2B companies, we also look at sales cycles, qualified pipeline and CRM revenue.

items.q: Do we need all four channels?
items.a: No. We start with the channels where your evidence is strongest and add the others only when a test shows they earn their place. Many mandates begin with two.

items.q: Can we see the evidence before making a commitment?
items.a: Yes. The Growth Diagnostic is a fixed-fee, six-week assessment. You get the account audit, the measurement review and a prioritised roadmap before deciding on a longer mandate.

items.q: Who owns the accounts and reporting?
items.a: You do. Ad accounts, tracking and dashboards sit in your organisation from day one, and we work inside them. If we part ways, everything stays with you.

blocks.text: This website is operated by ESEO LIMITED, a company based in Hong Kong, with its registered business address at 8/F., China Hong Kong Tower, 8–12 Hennessy Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong ("ESEO Marketing", "we", "us").

Providing this information is voluntary. However, without the contact details and relevant business information needed to assess your inquiry, we may be unable to respond or provide a consultation.

Our website and hosting infrastructure may process technical information necessary to deliver and secure the website, such as IP addresses, browser information and request logs. The exact information depends on the hosting configuration.

We use personal data to respond to consultation requests, assess potential engagements, prepare and administer contracts, communicate about our services, and maintain the operation and security of our website.
We do not sell personal data.
We do not use personal data for automated decision-making that produces legal or similarly significant effects.
We process personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including Hong Kong’s Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (PDPO).

Where the EU GDPR or UK GDPR applies, our legal bases may include steps taken at your request before entering into a contract, performance of a contract, legitimate interests in responding to business inquiries and operating our website, compliance with legal obligations, and consent where required.
Our website is not currently configured to use dedicated advertising or marketing tracking tools.
Essential cookies or similar technologies may be used where necessary for website functionality or security.
If analytics, advertising or other non-essential tracking technologies are introduced, we will update this policy and implement any consent mechanisms required by applicable law.
We may share personal data with service providers where necessary to operate our website, host its content, deliver communications or process consultation inquiries.

Where applicable data protection laws require safeguards for international transfers, we will implement appropriate measures before transferring personal data.
We retain personal data for as long as necessary to maintain business relationships, manage inquiries, fulfill contractual obligations, and comply with applicable legal requirements.
Personal data may be retained for extended periods where there is a legitimate and ongoing business purpose.
We periodically review the necessity of retaining such data and delete or anonymise information when it is no longer required, subject to applicable legal obligations.
We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, misuse, alteration or disclosure.
These measures are reviewed as appropriate to the nature of the information and the systems used to process it.
Subject to applicable law, you may request access to or correction of your personal data.
Where the GDPR or UK GDPR applies, you may also have rights to erasure, restriction of processing, objection, data portability and withdrawal of consent.
To exercise your rights, contact info@eseoads.com.
You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with the relevant data protection authority.
